{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wild Hunt''' was an ancient folk myth of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was thought that once every [[Standard year/Legends|year]], ethereal riders visible as dark figures with glowing [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] would come out of the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirit realm]] to gallop through the woods, shouting hunting-calls and taking with them any who crossed in their path.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], head [[shaman of the Nightsisters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], claimed in her instructional treatise on the Nightsisters entitled ''[[Wild Power]]'', to have personally witnessed a Wild Hunt. According to her, it was conjured by the [[Son/Legends|Fanged God]] when the four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of Dathomir were at their brightest and the snow had melted on the slopes of the [[Shattered Ridge]].<ref name="BOS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dathomiri Wild Hunt was inspired by the eponymous real life [[Wikipedia:Wild Hunt|Wild Hunt]].<ref name="BOS endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 4)}}</ref> Those fantasmal hunting parties were thought to be led by the Devil or a black-faced emissary of his.
